title: Primech A & P Named Platinum Sponsor of FMES 2026
summary: Primech A & P was recognised as Platinum Sponsor of FMES 2026, SIFMA's flagship summit for Singapore's facilities management industry.
body_markdown:
**


*Primech A & P was recognised by SIFMA as a Platinum Sponsor of the Facilities Management Experts Summit 2026, the industry’s flagship annual gathering.*


Primech A & P has been recognised as a Platinum Sponsor of the Facilities Management Experts Summit (FMES) 2026, organised by the Singapore International Facility Management Association (SIFMA). The recognition was presented to the Primech A & P team at the summit, marking our continued support for one of the most important gatherings on Singapore’s facilities management calendar.


This year’s summit carried the theme “One Ecosystem, Symbiotic Outcomes,” underscoring the importance of collaboration across service providers, service buyers, technology partners, and the workforce — a theme that closely mirrors how Primech A & P approaches its own work across public and private sector facilities.


## **A Gathering for the Industry, Not Just an Event**


FMES is SIFMA’s flagship annual conference, bringing together senior leaders, policymakers, and industry practitioners from across Singapore’s facilities management and built environment sectors. As a premier platform for thought leadership and industry exchange, the summit fosters dialogue on national priorities, sector transformation, and the future readiness of Singapore’s built environment.


Our team headed down to FMES 2026 and came away energised by the conversations happening across the industry — from smart FM solutions to sustainability and workforce development. Beyond the formal programme, the day was as much about reconnecting with familiar faces and meeting new ones as it was about the ideas shared on stage.


## **Why We Sponsor FMES**


Primech A & P officially joined SIFMA in March 2025, reinforcing our commitment to industry excellence, best practices, and the future of Singapore’s built environment sector. Stepping up as a Platinum Sponsor of FMES 2026 builds on that membership — it’s a chance to support the platform where the industry sets its direction, not just attend it.


- Supporting SIFMA’s educational programmes and collaborative initiatives on smart FM solutions, sustainability, and workforce development.
- Contributing to a shared industry conversation on how service providers, service buyers, and technology partners can work together more effectively.
- Strengthening relationships across the facilities management ecosystem in Singapore, from policymakers to fellow service providers.


## **Building on a Track Record of Industry Involvement**


This sponsorship adds to a growing list of industry recognitions for Primech A & P, including a 2024 LowCarbonSG Awardee distinction and, more recently, a LowCarbonSG Gold Award for verified year-on-year emissions reductions. Together, these milestones reflect a broader pattern: Primech A & P isn’t just delivering facility services — we’re actively investing in the standards, sustainability, and future direction of the industry itself.


## **Looking Ahead**


We’re grateful to SIFMA and everyone who made FMES 2026 such a meaningful gathering for the community, and we look forward to continuing to support the platforms that bring Singapore’s facilities management industry together. If you’d like to learn more about Primech A & P’s role in the industry or explore how we can support your facility’s needs, get in touch with our team.


## **About SIFMA and FMES**


The Singapore International Facility Management Association (SIFMA) is the leading association representing the interests of Singapore’s facility management industry, fostering collaboration, professional development, and policy advocacy. The Facilities Management Experts Summit (FMES) is SIFMA’s flagship annual conference, bringing together senior leaders, policymakers, and practitioners from across the FM and built environment sectors.
